hints.title: Key on First Element
hints.text: Since all integers in arr and pieces are distinct, map each piece leading element to the piece itself.

hints.title: Traverse Array Sequentially
hints.text: Starting from index 0 in arr, find the piece that begins with arr[i].

hints.title: Verify Matching Sequence
hints.text: Verify each element in that piece matches the consecutive elements in arr, advancing i accordingly.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching all pieces linearly at each position takes O(n * p) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A hash map indexed by the first integer of each piece provides O(1) piece lookup.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should notice distinct values constraint and use leading element hash lookup.
